text:
Jordan M.: OK folks — IntelEdge preview lab will be available next Tue for hardware validation. Need three things before we kick off: signed NDA from partner, benchmark run plan (latency/throughput/quantized vs full), and telemetry hooks so we can collect perf + power. Who can take telemetry?
Maria L.: I can own telemetry integration. Will need SSH creds for the lab nodes and a list of expected metrics (power, GPU util, temp, p99 latency).
Jordan M.: awesome — Maria owns telemetry. Kevin P., can you own the bench plan + runs? want a canary on a single node then distributed runs.
Kevin P.: Yep. I'll draft a minimal bench matrix: 
- seq: 128, 512, 1024
- batch: 1, 8, 16
- modes: fp16, int8
- metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, throughput (tokens/s), memory, power (watts)
I'll run a smoke script first.
Kevin P.: sample command i'll use:
```bash
./rbench --target 10.2.3.45 --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --mode int8 --out /tmp/int8_1024.json
```
Ash S.: I'll own marketplace & packaging checks (listing, icons, billing SKU mapping). Need legal for the NDA blurb and partner co-marketing checklist.
Jordan M.: NDA link is in the drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-redwood/inteledge-nda (partner requested redlined copy by EOD Fri).
Maria L.: infra-bot — can you provision the telemetry endpoint (prometheus pushgateway + s3 bucket for raw dumps)?
infra-bot: Provision request received. Lab nodes (10.2.3.45-10.2.3.48) assigned. Prometheus pushgateway: https://prom.push.redwood.internal/job/inteledge-preview. S3 bucket: s3://redwood-preview-inteledge.
Kevin P.: noted. i'll push benchmark outputs to the s3 path and add metadata JSON with run config. Maria — i'll include the tags you need: node_id, firmware, driver_version.
Maria L.: perfect. Also +1 on adding a small agent that emits NVML gpu_power and nvml_util every 5s; i'll ship a tiny sysmon container.
Ash S.: timeline check — can we do canary run Thu 10am PT? marketing wants a quick ops blurb to tee up the partner blog if numbers look good.
Jordan M.: Thur 10am PT works. Kevin: can you aim to have smoke run finished Wed EOD so we can fix any infra issues?
Kevin P.: will do.
Maria L.: I'll validate telemetry by Wed noon.
Jordan M.: legal to confirm NDA redline status by Fri morning — @legal FYI. Also, keep the partner looped: I'll send them the canary schedule and the telemetry collection consent.
Ash S.: noted — i'll draft the marketplace blurb after canary.
Jordan M.: Great. Action items: Maria (telemetry integration + sysmon container), Kevin (bench matrix + smoke run + S3 artifacts), Ash (marketplace & co-marketing checklist), Jordan (partner comms + NDA follow). Reactions: :thumbsup: if you're good with above.
Kevin P.: :thumbsup:
Maria L.: :thumbsup:
Ash S.: :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder set for Thu 10:00 PT canary run -> #release-war-room and DM owners.
Jordan M.: thanks — closing thread. If anything blocks, ping here or DM me. :eyes:
